verdict.rationale: Rollbar publishes its own API reference at docs.rollbar.com/reference. It has per-endpoint pages (e.g. GET /api/1/items) with worked query examples, and is backed by a downloadable OpenAPI 3.1 spec. Nothing in the evidence shows the reference is interactive or that examples can be executed in-browser, so only the reference-with-examples part of the story is evidenced. Missing for 10: documented interactive 'try it' or runnable-request capability, evidence that examples execute against the live API, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: The Rollbar API provides a RESTful interface to much of the data in the system.
